blocks.text: There is something about gathering around a table, sharing good food, discovering a remarkable bottle, and raising a glass with friends that never goes out of style. For Philippine Wine Merchants (PWM), that spirit of togetherness is at the heart of the 23rd Grand Wine Experience, returning on November 20, 2026, to the Marriott Grand Ballroom at Newport World Resorts. This year’s theme, Santé, the French expression used when toasting to good health, invites guests to celebrate life’s pleasures, meaningful connections, and the simple joy of being together.
